name: Apache SalesRoom
rootCause: A Rug Pull occurred on the Apache NFT SalesRoom (ASN) on the BNB Chain, and the deployer made a profit of about $680,000. The deployer transferred a large number of tokens to the address starting with 0xdc8, which has now dumped 1 million ASNs at a price of $680,000 in BSC-USD.
